{{Top|leg}}
'''Short-range communication''' was a skill possessed by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] of the same clan. Through complex combinations of [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], Weequays of the same clan could communicate silently, allowing them to easily track and corner their prey. In the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] enforcer [[Grimorg]] and his clanmates used this ability to great effect.
